_about: The app's prices and free-tier numbers, as the site states them. The iOS repo's scripts/check_site_facts.py compares this file (as served at https://preflopapp.com/facts.json) against Preflop.storekit and FreeTierConfig, and scripts/check-site.py here fails any page whose numbers disagree with it. Change a price or a free-tier number in the app, then here, then in the pages; the two checks catch whichever was forgotten.
_spots: practiceSpots is how many practice spots the app bundles (counted from its content files; 6,431 at 100bb, 19,048 at 20/30bb). The site rounds DOWN to practiceSpotsShown and writes it as '25,000+'; check-site.py fails any 'N,NNN+' on the site that is not that figure. The app's check_site_facts.py ignores these keys.
